title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 29 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 28 March 2026 Mainly dry and warm weather will prevail over most parts of the island, except for showers or thundershowers that may occur at a few places in Rathnapura, Kaluthara, Galle, and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
